The '''Short Range Transit Shuttle SST-67''' (also referred to as the "[[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] Shuttle") was one of many [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies|SST]] models of intra-system [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] from [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]].

==Characteristics==
A user-friendly model designed for civilian use, the SST-67 was unarmed, shieldless, and had minimal armor. Its systems were easily accessed from inside and out for easy maintenance. The controls and sensor suites were recycled from a failed freighter design and easily mastered. The [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and [[Communications array/Legends|communications arrays]] could be easily upgraded to full automation.<ref name="Ionosphere" />

The shuttle was 23.2 meters long. The ship required a single pilot, who was seated in a small cabin. The gangplank led to a passenger area with benches to accommodate eighteen. To either side of the gangplank were a storage area and weapons locker respectively, allowing a total cargo of one metric ton and consumables for two days. Being for intra-system use, the design lacked a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Ionosphere" />

==History==
Sienar contracted with the governments of Naboo and other lightly-populated worlds to provide the inexpensive but efficient ships. A new SST-67 cost 82,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]; a used one cost only 20,000 credits.<ref name="Ionosphere" />

Naboo shuttles were often used for trips between Naboo and [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Worlohp]] piloted one such shuttle called the ''[[Fair Gale]]''.<ref name="Ionosphere" />
